title: Vehicle vector artwork
summary: Shared optional Canvas/WebGL hull and flame data.

blocks.text: This module contributes the standard vector appearance for the orbital trainer ship (spacelab.trainer/orbit-trainer). It defines screen-space hull geometry (+X forward chevron outline with four vertices) and thruster flame geometry for Canvas 2D and WebGL 2 renderers. The artwork is purely cosmetic presentation data and never alters vessel mass, propulsion, collision bounds, flight mechanics or saved games.

items: The module provides no service keys, requiring no runtime dependencies.
Contributes a VehicleAppearance definition via context.contributeVehicleAppearance for vehicle ID spacelab.trainer/orbit-trainer.
Contributes this usage guide for creators and the flight guide for players.
Initialization contributes trainerAppearance to the module context and registers creator and player documentation guides.
The module owns no persistent runtime state or active timers.
Renderers retrieve vehicle appearance via createVehicleArtwork and draw the chevron hull and throttle flame during frame rendering.

blocks.text: Removing or replacing this module causes renderers to fall back to the generic four-point box marker (VEHICLE_MARKER) when drawing the trainer. Handling and flight characteristics remain unaffected. To provide alternative vehicle artwork, implement a presentation module calling contributeVehicleAppearance with custom geometry.
Module version 0.1.0 uses API space-sim-game-api/2 and manifest format space-sim-module/2. Both are pre-freeze. Vehicle ID is spacelab.trainer/orbit-trainer.
examples/modules/appearance-trainer demonstrates contributing custom vehicle vector appearance artwork and assembling a VehicleArtwork catalog. Build and validate it from the repository root:

npm run module:build -- examples/modules/appearance-trainer/module.json /tmp/example-trainer-appearance.spacemod
npm run module:validate -- /tmp/example-trainer-appearance.spacemod
